text: Evaluate the policy efficacy of the Philippines' POEA Memorandum Circular 14-2017 (PH-HK domestic-worker zero placement fee). Specifically: what's the documented compliance rate among licensed agencies; what's the documented behaviour change in employer-paid vs worker-paid fee splits; what gap remains between the rule and the lived experience of returning workers; and what alternative policy designs (graduated-fee, employer-pays-with-rebate, escrow-bond-only) have been proposed and why?

Evaluate the documented compliance with the Saudi 2021 Labour Reform Initiative + Qatar 2020 reforms + UAE 2022 amendments specifically for migrant domestic workers (the workers excluded from most kafala-dismantling reforms). What changed on paper, what changed in practice, and what does the data show 5 years post-reform?

For OFW recovery cases that go through POEA Anti-Illegal Recruitment Branch + the joint-and-several-liability mechanism under RA 10022 §15, what's the documented recovery-percentage range based on POEA escrow data 2018-2024? Cite primary sources, named cases where possible. End with the methodological caveat about case-selection bias.
